# `organizations` — module reference

Rendered from the module's own manifest, and from nothing written by hand. What the module *does* is [its own page](../modules/organizations.md).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Module id | `organizations` |
| Name | Organizations |
| Version | `1.1.0` |
| Ships from | `@endora-commerce/mod-organizations` |
| Licence tier | — |

## Activation

**This module cannot be switched off.** The single unit of tenancy — every organization-scoped entity, membership and transacting customer resolves through it; switched off, the platform has no tenant.

| `customer_accounts` | gating only | resolves `customerAccountReadPort`; withheld from `dependencies` because the install order cannot carry the edge |
